note: agent-decomposed 2026-09-22 (stasis round 3). A rules spec (§3 don'ts D1-D8, §4 do's A1-A10) whose graduation trigger is: every rule cited by a landed package or retired by a measurement, AND sprint T12 has chosen the §5 budgets with receipt paths, AND the D6 condition. Items are those graduation obligations plus the rules that need an enforcing construct; D3's qualifier is owned by the cell-qualified contract.

items.text: §5 budgets: sprint T12 chooses the P1-P5 numbers (local-save, open-with LAN, cross-peer visibility, recovery, idle cost per context) with receipt paths under genesis/a2o/reports/
Graduation audit: each §3/§4 rule cited by a landed package (bundle, candidate or manifest addition) or retired by an overturning measurement
D5 enforcement: a bundle never carries a DNA — gate the packaging path to refuse DNA-bearing bundles
D3 enforcement: no projected row or sync doc without its cell qualifier (owned by the cell-qualified projection contract)
A5: candidates are single-role and appliesTo names the target's running coordinators
A6: witness identity reproducible — DNA packing only from the canonical path, only as a fleet operation
A8: record the resolved composition, recoverable and readable by Shefa
D8: cross-peer wake-up carried by a notification, never by DHT signals (cell-local post_commit)
§6 twelve-line package-author checklist folded into the p2p-design-gate / package-authoring skill so authors meet it at authoring time
